'''Feryl''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] [[Mind Walkers|Mind Walker]] present on [[Sinkhole Station]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] during [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] visit there in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. Feryl and another Mind Walker, [[Seek Ryontarr]], served as Skywalker's guides when they traveled to a realm of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] known as [[beyond shadows]].
